simple.meaning: צָרָה (tsârâh) is a Hebrew object word meaning “tightness (i.e. figuratively, trouble ); transitively, a female rival.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Genesis 35:3. The surrounding context includes family, family line, altar, land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to צָרָה (H6869) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
